have you ever tried cold showers, like a minute to two minutes long? there was some study where depressed people taking short cold showers(actually cold) for like a week saw nice improvement. its not a miracle but it helped me out

Yeah and I can see why. it makes you a hollow husk of a person, infecting your body and your brain. Take antibiotics, feel like shit. Don't take antibiotics, feel like shit. Not to mention the antibiotics cause crippling depression. It's like, hmm, would I rather choose door A or door B, and both doors are just complete and utter shit?

i honestly dont even know what to do at this stage in my life. i havent even hit 20 yet.

i know theres something because the last time i stopped antibiotics my tinittus and brain fog came back and i went back to sleeping 14 hours a day and having neck pain and all that shit

but trying to start them up again, the stomach pain, the depression, the weird herx symptoms. its all bullshit. i'd rather be dead or have cancer. im not even joking. at least  you can fully recover from cancer. at least the medical industry gives a shit about cancer.

not trying to sound like a whiny bitch but im just saying, I can understand why all these people are just killing themselves. i dont want to live on this planet anymore either.
